reviews.title: Perfect for Desktop PC Gaming. Makes Any Game Available Look Gorgeous!
reviews.comment: Upgrading one monitor in a 2 x 24" flatscreen dual-monitor setup to this beauty. Primary use will be gaming and it doesn't shy away from a brilliant, fast display on even the most demanding games. Thoroughly love everything about this. Just the right size and shape for desktop pc gaming!

reviews.title: Inexpensive LARGE monitor for WFH usage
reviews.comment:
Purchased this as a 2nd monitor off my work laptop (used in a work from home office).  It is bright and clear.  I use it for MS Office tools and other similar tools, so I can't speak to the ability to use it for gaming or videos/movies (I have used it for Teams/Zoom meetings with video, but the quality of the images there is poor and based on the camera being used so I can't judge it on HD video quality or anything.  I am using it slightly off center (15-20 degree angle) and it is fine.
It is a GREAT addition to my WFH situation and I am able to get multiple windows/programs up and in use (helps with my old eyes).  Set up was straightforward (it's plug and play).
reviews.author: DMacNJ
